pmc-11355481.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We used whole transcriptome analysis (RNA-Seq) to compare patterns of gene expression in the olfactory mucosa of the pig and two subspecies of wild boar (Sus scrofa), and investigate candidate genes that could be responsible for the loss of olfactory capacity.

Because EGFR‐TKI treatment alters the tumor microenvironment, biomarkers predictive of ICI response are ideally identified post‐EGFR‐TKI resistance, but obtaining repeat biopsies at this time can be challenging.
